lexical_plain: Helped Kirfan pull up debris from the broken structure from upriver.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Bubbles is too panicked and bites the mage hand.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn uses ice to freeze the base of the rock and make a platform.

lexical_plain: Bonogo dives in the water, Baergrom loses the rope.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo flows downstream and has a wonderful zen underwater adventure.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Stafl gathers town support, nets are dropped across the bridge flow ways.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Ready for some rest, ready to not be covered in the sweat and ichor of the day, Caelynn, Karsemine, Stafl, Baergrom, and Ephanna accepted the offer of a ride to StoneBridge with Pippa.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Pippa a bright and talkative Gnome obsessed with crafting and understanding beer, hitched up Bubbles the Float Goat to her wagon full of kegs and led the crew to a dock and barge on the river.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Along the way down river, they encountered an elderly fisherman, whose net was stuck.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Without missing a beat Bonogo out of selflessness and hopes for a giant fish to eat, dove into the water to find the damned net didn't have a fish, stupid useless net.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: With some trial and error and stradling of boats Stafl and Baergrom I think pulled the net to surface to see it looked to be the corner beams of a roof.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Once at StoneBridge and unloading beer, it became clear a storm was coming.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Hitching up Bubbles and the barge, into the River's Edge Pub for a welcome round of beers and some bragging to Grishna about their adventures.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Inside was the evening crew, Grishna, patrons, and another bard!

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Who Stafl immediately joined in a jam with that undoubtedly demonstrated his superior song craft and bardic talents.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: After some excellent drinks and music, Pippa realizes the loud drumming isn't just the bard, but a torrent of rain on the roof excuses herself to check on Bubbles.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Gone for a few moments, during a pause in the retelling of the day's events, weeping is heard from another table, followed by a piercing yell in between cascades of rain off the roof.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: "BUBBLES!"

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Dropping everything and rushing outside, you found Pippa, soaked and panicked.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Gripping onto the front of the pub holding on in rushing water up to her waste.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: "Help!

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: I can't find Pippa" she babbles about a broken lead.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Rapidly searching around Bubbles is found wildly bleating on a rock in the river.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Out on a rickety dock, shaking in the flood and downpour, the river frothing, rapids crashing all around as it wildly rushed.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: a lasso was made and handed to a mage hand Ephanna created.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Stafl runs for help, and gathers townfolk to set nets across the river.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo and Baergrom prepare for Bonogo to dive in.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn desperately fires ice bolts to freeze a platform around Bubble's rock.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Stafl began banging on doors and assisting townfolk escape the flood and gather at the pub on high ground.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Sending the mage hand and rope out to Bubbles, the Float Goat panics and bites, destroying the mage hand and dropping the rope into the water.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Desperate to save (maybe to eat, raw?

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Or maybe in a curry?

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Thoroughly fermented) Bonogo dives into the river with full trust in Baergrom to hold the rope, which is immediately torn out of Baergrom's hand.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Unprepared for the speed with which the river carries Bonogo away, the rope and Bonogo are gone.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: The only remenant, the end of the rope whipping across the top of the river, vanishing out of sight.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: In the face of a rapidly deteriorating situation, Karsemine cast Zephyr strike and ran down the bank, shooting arrows at wear Bonogo probably was.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Stafl and Caelynn cut loose a dinghy and let the river take them after Bonogo, with only a net with light cast on it and hope.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna and the mage hand coaxed Bubbles to the lasso and were able to get her to the dock across the ice path and rushing river.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Where Ephanna hopped on Bubbles back and followed after the runaway boats.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo was rescued, the wet adventurers headed to the Pub to find a damp, but generally relieved, safe, and drying town.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Collapsing to sleep, they woke up the next day with the most important question of all.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: What now?

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Sure they were heroes of Stone Bridge, and definitely the saviors of Bubbles the Float Goat, but so what?

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: What about that city Pippa was talking about, where they were having a festival?

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Mirathorn, that might be interesting... Long way on foot, but not that far.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Maybe a bit more than a week.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
lexical_plain: Not much to do around Stone Bridge unless you are into rebuilding and staying still.
